description: Get place/geofence/region context for coordinates using Radar. Returns geofences, the containing place, and administrative region (country/state/postal code) for a lat/lng. Example: radar_context({ lat: 40.70390, lon: -73.98670, _apiKey: "prj_live_sk_..." })

_apiKey.description: Radar API key (get one free at radar.com)

name: radar_context
title: Radar Context
